author: A Google user
review_text: Well finally payment via internet is on. I liked this feature. Hope to see more new ones in the coming days.  Edit 1: While I made the payment to one of the ISP (Vianet), I got there a problem for verification of the payment. eSewa said it is being paid, but Vianet showed it isn't. Though the issue was resolved and being verified.  It would be better if we could pay those ISP's via the mobile eSewa app rather than it taking to the webpage. That would be great if being made happened, with entering the Customer ID and the plan payment selection.  Thanks.
